summary: Elliptic Laboratories ASA, an artificial intelligence (AI) software company, engages in the provision of AI virtual smart sensors for the smartphone, laptop, Internet of Things, and automotive markets in Norway, the United States, China, South Korea, Taiwan, and Japan. The company offers AI Virtual Human Presence Sensor, a presence-detection solution used to improve the security of data stored on devices and to allow intuitive responses based on natural human interaction; AI Virtual Proximity Sensor that enables exquisite full-screen devices; and AI Virtual Connection Sensor that allows pair and authenticate smart devices that are in the same room using ultrasound. It also provides AI Virtual Position Sensor which automatically detects the location of an external display in relation to a laptop; AI Virtual Gesture Sensor that enables touchless user interactions; AI Virtual Breathing sensor that enables to track person's breathing; and AI Virtual heartbeat Sensor that tracks a person's heart rate. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
